name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: At Stonewrought Dam, Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII suspects sabotage and sends a powder sample north for examination. A courier must carry it through the Wetlands to demolition expert Ashlan Stonesmirk at Dun Modr.

sections.title: A Powder of Ill Intent
sections.body: A suspicious barrel near the dam’s eastern ramp held a strange-smelling powder. Hinderweir had seen Dark Iron sappers nearby, and suspects the powder is a refined explosive meant to shatter dwarven masonry. The dam has no specialized equipment to test it. Before he can be certain, he needs a military demolitionist to examine the sample.

sections.title: The Road North
sections.body: The road runs through the Algaz Gate and down into the sodden lowlands of the Wetlands. Hostile wildlife, aggressive dragonkin, and Dark Iron infiltrators make the way dangerous. Hinderweir urges couriers to keep to the cobbled road to Dun Modr. The pillaged dwarven town stands at the southern approach to the Thandol Span, where an Ironforge regiment still keeps watch.

sections.title: The Blast Expert of Dun Modr
sections.body: At Dun Modr, Ashlan Stonesmirk is the regiment’s master of high explosives. Decades of concussive blasts have left him half-deaf. His keen eye and nose confirm the powder is a specialized demolition charge. Its presence points to an orchestrated plot against the heart of dwarven engineering.

faq.q: What is the strange smelling powder?
faq.answer: The strange-smelling powder is an alchemical explosive charge collected near Stonewrought Dam. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII suspects saboteurs mean to breach the dam walls with it.

faq.q: Why send the powder all the way to Dun Modr?
faq.answer: Dun Modr houses the Ironforge military contingent defending the Thandol Span, including Ashlan Stonesmirk. He is a veteran explosives expert with the technical knowledge to identify specialized blast compounds.
Ashlan Stonesmirk is stationed at Dun Modr’s military camp, in the far northern Wetlands just south of the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Why does Hinderweir warn to stick to the road?
faq.answer: Hinderweir warns couriers to stay on the road down from the Algaz Gate because hostile beasts, raptors, gnolls, and Dark Iron saboteurs roam the Wetlands. Travel away from the road is extremely dangerous.

faq.q: Who is sabotaging the Stonewrought Dam?
faq.answer: The explosives belong to the Dark Iron dwarves, who seek to undermine Bronzebeard infrastructure and collapse Stonewrought Dam, drowning the valleys below.

faq.q: Why is Ashlan Stonesmirk hard of hearing?
faq.answer: Frontline work as a military sapper and explosives specialist has left Ashlan with chronic ringing in his ears and severe hearing loss from blast concussions.

angles.text: Stonewrought Dam is one of the crowning jewels of Bronzebeard engineering. A plot to shatter its masonry threatens the pride and safety of all Khaz Modan.
Identifying high-grade explosive residues takes a sapper’s practiced eye. Even ordinary powders can reveal an enemy saboteur’s technical skill.
The highway through Loch Modan and the Wetlands is a critical military lifeline between Ironforge and the northern Alliance holdings across the Thandol Span.
